heading: Could Dog Grooming Be Your Next Chapter?
blockquote: It is never too late to build a career doing something you genuinely enjoy.
body:
Many of our students come to us from completely different careers. Some are facing redundancy, returning to work or looking for greater flexibility. Others have simply reached the point where they want their working life to feel more rewarding.

Dog grooming can offer the chance to work with animals, develop a creative and practical skill, become employed within a salon or build a business of your own. Whatever has brought you here, we will help you understand the route ahead and develop the confidence, practical ability and industry knowledge needed to take your next step.
